description:
Make the `scripts/workflow-contract-selftest.sh` self-test pass as the registered gate `workflow-contract-selftest` over the script it tests.

## Background

`scripts/workflow-contract-selftest.sh` is a re-runnable self-test of `scripts/workflow-contract.sh` over the case vectors in `test-vectors/workflow-contract/`, showing that the harness rejects the defects it claims to reject. It exits 2 when `python3` is missing. Until planning, no gate ran it. The gate `workflow-contract-selftest` was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning, so this task and the container can require it; this task makes it pass and keeps its inputs complete. Only `.github/workflows/ci.yml:54` runs it today, so a local gate run never does.

Its actionlint-wiring layer (`:119-135`) prints `SKIP` and passes when the entry point reports an environment error because actionlint is unavailable, so the actionlint defect seeds go unproven.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `workflow-contract-selftest` runs `scripts/workflow-contract-selftest.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `workflow-contract-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
- [hard] REQ-03: When actionlint is unavailable, the self-test exits non-zero naming the missing tool; no branch prints a skip notice and continues to a passing exit.
title: Workflow-contract harness self-test runs as a declared gate
